name: Derrick Van Orden
bio: a Representative from Wisconsin; born in Hennepin County, Minn., September 15, 1969; B.S., Excelsior University, Albany, NY; United States Navy, 1988-2014; actor; business owner; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Seventeenth Congress in 2020; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighteenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2023-present).
